verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official docs explicitly cover installing NVIDIA drivers (ubuntu-docs-16), which supports GPU vendor driver installation, and Ubuntu's general developer/AI-ML tooling messaging (ubuntu-docs-1, ubuntu-docs-6) implies support for accelerated workloads. However there is no documentation or evidence about building custom kernel modules (e.g., DKMS workflow, kernel headers, module signing/secure boot handling), and one older community comment notes friction with proprietary driver blobs (ubuntu-comm-16), suggesting the experience isn't seamless. missing for 10: DKMS/kernel module build documentation, evidence of secure-boot module signing support, and independent hands-on confirmation of successful custom kernel module builds.
